verdict.rationale: Rootly documents that escalation policies notify responders, and it pages responders in Microsoft Teams. It also has an iOS/Android on-call mobile app, but the excerpt is truncated and never explicitly mentions push notifications. That makes this a thin multi-channel paging capability rather than the full story. missing for 10: explicit push notification paging, outbound SMS paging, outbound phone-call paging (Live Call Routing is inbound only), email paging, user-configurable per-channel notification rules, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, pages reach me over the channels I choose — push, SMS, phone call, and email — with per-channel notification rules

citations.quote: Escalation Policies define **how Rootly notifies responders when an alert requires attention**
Rootly On-Call now pages responders, posts alerts, and lets them acknowledge, escalate, and resolve right in Microsoft Teams.
Rootly mobile app for iOS and Android on-ca
